summary: Local owner/member access controls passed adversarial emulator checks. The intended real-money group wallet is not implemented, so the complete product cannot yet be assessed as ready for financial use. No production rules were published.

findings.issue: The app records group consent but has no trusted contribution, settlement, penalty or refund workflow.
findings.recommendation: Keep money movement disabled until a payment provider is selected and server workflows verify unanimous consent, actual costs, idempotency and reconciliation.

findings.issue: Invitations use supplied member IDs; customer lookup and replacement/cancellation flows are not implemented.
findings.recommendation: Add verified invitation acceptance and reviewed membership transitions before treating proposals as funded bookings.

verified_controls: Account type is owner-readable and immutable after registration.
Customers cannot create provider listings; providers cannot create customer booking requests.
Mirrored bookings require consistent ownership, authoritative deposits and unpaid state.
Group terms are immutable; approvals are member-owned and shares are validated.
Withdrawal requests remove individual approval; another member cannot approve or withdraw on their behalf.
Wallet balances and transactions reject all mobile-client writes.
Missing group parents and outsider reads are denied.
Missing listings cannot receive new group approvals.
Profile photo writes/deletes are verified-owner-only, with file type/size enforcement on creation and replacement.

verification.expo_production_exports: web, Android and iOS passed on 8 October 2026
